topic: Your brain does something weird when someone ignores you
title: Your brain does something weird when someone ignores you
hook: Your brain does something weird when someone ignores you.
lines: You text them. Nothing. Hours pass.
And suddenly you can't stop thinking about them.
Psychologists link this to something called the Zeigarnik effect.
Your brain hates open loops. An unanswered message is an unfinished story.
So it keeps replaying it, looking for closure.
The less attention they give you, the more attention your brain gives them.
That's why silence can feel louder than an argument.
Here's the twist: it was never about them.
outro: It's your brain trying to close a loop. Who are you still waiting on?
description: Why being ignored makes you think about someone even more. Psychologists connect it to open loops and the brain's need for closure.
